page: Microsoft Azure E32nds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Endv6 server family. It is equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system features 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration includes 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is designated as network-optimized and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the inclusion of high-capacity local NVMe SSD storage, this instance provides a resource-dense profile for memory-intensive operations without requiring GPU acceleration. The combination of dedicated Intel CPU cores, substantial memory capacity, and fast local storage makes it suitable for relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and memory-heavy enterprise workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure E32nds_v6 is a memory-optimized and network-optimized server from the Endv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated x86_64 Intel vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage needs are met by 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. With no integrated GPU, this server is designed for workloads requiring substantial memory and fast local storage rather than parallel graphics processing. The hardware configuration is suited for database hosting, memory-intensive enterprise applications, and analytical workloads that benefit from dedicated processing threads and high-speed local disk access.
